hypothesis: Maintain one persistent molecular-graph Markov chain from each fixed initial molecule, propose one fresh molecule per chain through a single reversible corpus-fragment add or delete transition, and use each returned oracle score in a Metropolis-Hastings decision targeting an annealed score density with the exact reverse-to-forward proposal probability ratio. Increase inverse temperature over the objective session so early chains can retain controlled downhill transitions while later decisions increasingly concentrate the chains on higher-scoring states.
method_thesis: Extract a vocabulary of single-attachment fragments from the allowed unlabeled corpus without scoring or retrieving any whole corpus molecule, and start one persistent molecular-graph Markov chain from each of the ten fixed evaluated molecules. In every feedback round, generate one fresh candidate per chain through a locally sanitized, reversible fragment-add or fragment-delete transition, retrying locally until the batch contains ten novel canonical molecules. After the oracle returns, accept each proposed state with a Metropolis-Hastings probability for an annealed score density, including its forward/reverse proposal ratio; rejected proposals leave their chains at the previous states. Low inverse temperature initially permits controlled downhill moves that can cross structural valleys, while increasing concentration later favors high-score states. Thus all oracle calls evaluate de novo molecular constructions, and feedback directly steers persistent search paths toward a stronger final Top-1 without a surrogate, a learned generator, or finite-library screening.

activation_observables.measurement: For every emitted canonical molecule, record its chain identifier, evaluated parent, add-or-delete move, corpus-derived fragment identity, attachment bond, and reconstructed reverse move; report the fraction produced by exactly one successful structural edit with a reverse move supported by the same kernel, plus separate add and delete counts, relative to a zero-transition baseline.
activation_observables.name: traceable_reversible_fragment_transition_rate

activation_observables.measurement: For every oracle-scored transition, record the total eligible move-record count in each direction, the multiplicity of move records yielding the realized canonical endpoint, and the resulting aggregate forward and reverse probabilities; report the fraction with finite positive probabilities in both directions and the distribution of the logged reverse-to-forward correction.
activation_observables.name: finite_forward_reverse_proposal_support

activation_observables.measurement: For every proposed transition whose new oracle score is below its chain state's score, record the current inverse temperature, score-density ratio, proposal correction, Metropolis-Hastings acceptance probability, uniform draw, and decision. Holding each observed score difference and proposal ratio fixed, also compute its acceptance probability at the schedule's initial and final inverse temperatures and report the mean final-minus-initial contrast together with actual downhill acceptance rates by session half.
activation_observables.name: annealed_downhill_acceptance_probability

activation_observables.measurement: After every observe message, report the fraction of scored proposals for which the recorded seeded draw and Metropolis-Hastings probability reproduce the accept-or-reject decision, the fraction of accepted moves installed as that chain's next state, and the fraction of rejected moves for which the previous state is retained; also count later proposals descended from accepted adaptive states.
activation_observables.name: persistent_chain_feedback_consistency

activation_observables.measurement: At every feedback boundary, record the mean and maximum oracle score of the ten current chain states, the fraction of chains above their own initial score, and the current inverse temperature; compare the chain-state score statistics between the first and second halves of the session while separately reporting accepted uphill and downhill transitions.
activation_observables.name: annealed_chain_score_concentration

activation_observables.measurement: For each suggestion round, report unique sanitized canonical offspring emitted per raw reversible-edit attempt, with separate counts for absent eligible moves, edit or sanitization failures, unchanged products, previously proposed molecules, and within-batch collisions, and verify that the emitted list equals the batch size announced by init.
activation_observables.name: valid_novel_reversible_edit_yield

applicability_conditions: The ten fixed initial molecules are sanitizable and have nonempty reversible add-or-delete neighborhoods under the prepared fragment vocabulary.
The unlabeled corpus yields a bounded set of chemically useful single-attachment fragments with enough support to define productive local edits without retrieving whole corpus molecules.
Objective values are stable and sufficiently varied for annealed score-density ratios to distinguish transitions and steer later chain states.
Useful high-scoring regions are connected to at least one initial chain by a sequence of the supported fragment additions and deletions, potentially including intermediate downhill steps.
Local editing, sanitization, and novelty filtering maintain enough yield to fill every protocol-announced batch before the evaluator's proposal-attempt limit.

The 290 adaptive calls provide enough transitions for persistent chains to mix before the increasing inverse temperature concentrates them; the method may underperform when improvements require coordinated nonlocal edits, fragments outside corpus support, or structural valleys too wide for the schedule and budget.
research_intent.falsifier: The root mechanism is falsified if emitted proposals cannot be traced to single fragment add-or-delete transitions with finite positive forward and reverse probability under the fixed uniform kernel, if recorded Metropolis-Hastings decisions do not reproduce the annealed score-density and proposal-ratio calculation, if accepted and rejected decisions do not respectively advance and retain their persistent chain states, or if increasing inverse temperature does not reduce the calculated acceptance probability of otherwise identical downhill transitions.
research_intent.implementation_change: Implement prepare mode to derive and publish a bounded, deduplicated vocabulary of single-attachment fragments and fixed proposal metadata from the unlabeled corpus, without retaining or ranking whole corpus molecules. Implement run mode to seed every RNG from init, canonicalize the fixed observations as persistent chain states, read the announced batch size, and assign each batch position to a chain. For each assigned chain, sample uniformly from its eligible reversible fragment-add and fragment-delete move records, sanitize and canonicalize the edited graph, locally retry invalid, unchanged, previously proposed, or within-batch duplicate products, and retain parent, edit, fragment, and forward-kernel provenance for every emitted molecule. After observe, compute the aggregate forward and reverse probabilities of the realized canonical transition under the same uniform kernel, apply the seeded Metropolis-Hastings test using the old and new oracle scores and a deterministic increasing inverse-temperature schedule based only on consumed budget, advance the chain only on acceptance, and otherwise preserve its prior evaluated state.
research_intent.mechanism: Maintain one persistent molecular-graph Markov chain from each fixed initial molecule, propose one fresh molecule per chain through a single reversible corpus-fragment add or delete transition, and use each returned oracle score in a Metropolis-Hastings decision targeting an annealed score density with the exact reverse-to-forward proposal probability ratio. Increase inverse temperature over the objective session so early chains can retain controlled downhill transitions while later decisions increasingly concentrate the chains on higher-scoring states.
research_intent.observed_bottleneck: With only 290 adaptive oracle calls after the ten fixed initial molecules, a de novo optimizer must use each sparse batch of feedback immediately while continuing to produce valid novel structures, and it must cross locally unfavorable structural steps without relying on a smooth surrogate, a learned policy, or screening a finite corpus pool.

applicability_conditions: The corpus and fixed initial panel support the structural generator in the short run: each session loaded 64 single-attachment fragments, initialized all ten sanitizable chains, and completed 19 ten-molecule batches.

The evidence supports single corpus-fragment additions and deletions as a forward-only de novo proposal mechanism with canonicalization and provenance; it does not support treating the novelty-filtered emitted process as a reversible Markov kernel.

A valid reversible-MH interpretation requires reverse endpoints, including evaluated parents, to remain in proposal support and requires q_forward and q_reverse to include the normalization induced by validity, novelty, retry, and within-batch conditioning. Those conditions do not hold here.

The annealing arithmetic is directionally supported only for nonsaturated downhill cases: 139/373 paired final-beta contrasts were negative, while 234/373 were unchanged at zero contrast because the raw proposal ratio saturated acceptance.
Persistent-chain installation and retention are supported for all 950 scored transitions under the implemented accept/reject rule, independent of whether that rule is valid MH.

Objective-specific concentration is not supported under the observed score scale and proposal asymmetry: only drd2_docking increased its later-half mean chain score, and all five objectives followed the same molecular and decision path.

Sustained operation at batch size 10 and budget 300 is not supported. Applicability is limited to the first 190 adaptive calls in this replica, before global novelty and local edit constraints prevent a complete batch.
Evidence is limited to screening seed 0; no Parent evaluation exists and no task completed the intended annealing schedule.

observable_measurements.name: traceable_reversible_fragment_transition_rate
observable_measurements.parent_value: No Parent Algorithm Node exists for this lineage root. The pre-registered zero-transition trace reference has composite reversible-transition rate 0.0.
observable_measurements.value: Seed 0 across five tasks produced 950 oracle-scored canonical offspring in 95 completed batches. All 950 had a distinct evaluated parent and candidate, chain id, add-or-delete label, corpus-fragment id, operation-specific attachment record, and the opposite reconstructed raw edit; the structural-edit-only trace rate was therefore 950/950 = 1.0, comprising 485 additions and 465 deletions (97 additions and 93 deletions per task). The registered composite rate is nevertheless 0/950 under the proposal kernel that actually emits molecules. Initial molecules are inserted into self.forbidden at optimize.py lines 464-475, every emitted candidate is inserted at lines 769-773, and lines 757-759 reject any subsequently generated endpoint in that set. Thus every transition's evaluated parent is forbidden when the reverse is later proposed: the raw graph edit can reconstruct it, but the same emitted kernel assigns that reverse endpoint probability zero. The logs' reported rate 1.0 measures labels and an unfiltered structural move, not a reversible emitted transition.

observable_measurements.name: finite_forward_reverse_proposal_support
observable_measurements.parent_value: No Parent Algorithm Node exists for this lineage root; the zero-transition reference has no supported forward/reverse proposal pair and corresponds to support fraction 0.0.
observable_measurements.value: The logs report positive finite raw-edit probabilities for 950/950 scored transitions: forward probabilities ranged from 0.00019054878048780488 to 0.0078125 (median 0.0011160714285714285) and reverse probabilities from 0.0001816860465116279 to 0.0078125 (median 0.0026041666666666665). Logged forward choice counts ranged 64-2624 (median 704) and reverse choice counts 64-2816 (median 192). Forward multiplicities were 1 for 760 transitions, 2 for 175, and 3 for 15; reverse multiplicities were 1 for 885 and 2 for 65. The logged log(reverse/forward) correction had minimum -3.761200115693563, quartiles -3.3672958299864737, 1.8458266904983311, and 2.8903717578961654, maximum 3.713572066704308, mean -0.042590043087764075, and was nonzero on all 950 transitions. These numbers exactly describe the single raw draw at lines 586-730, but not the emitted proposal distribution: lines 750-764 repeatedly discard absent, invalid, globally forbidden, and batch-colliding draws until a survivor is found, without normalizing q over survivors, and the forbidden-parent invariant makes actual reverse support zero. Hence the fraction with finite positive probabilities in both directions under the actual proposal kernel is 0/950, not the logged 1.0.

observable_measurements.name: annealed_downhill_acceptance_probability
observable_measurements.parent_value: No Parent Algorithm Node exists. The registered paired reference is the same 373 transitions evaluated at the schedule's initial beta, whose mean logged acceptance probability was 0.6578522669024285.
observable_measurements.value: For the implemented calculation, all required fields were logged on 373 downhill scored transitions. Holding each logged score difference and raw q ratio fixed, mean acceptance probability was 0.6578522669024285 at beta 0.75 and 0.6468149345489284 at beta 28.0, for mean final-minus-initial contrast -0.011037332353500138; 139 contrasts were negative, 234 were zero because the raw q ratio saturated acceptance at 1, and none were positive. Actual downhill acceptance fell from 237/315 = 0.7523809523809524 in the schedule's observed first half to 4/58 = 0.06896551724137931 in its observed second half. The sessions terminated at beta 7.148614539614657 rather than reaching beta 28.0. The arithmetic and seeded decisions are reproducible, but these are not valid Metropolis-Hastings probabilities for the filtered retry-until-survivor kernel because their q terms omit its normalization and zero reverse support.

observable_measurements.name: persistent_chain_feedback_consistency
observable_measurements.parent_value: No Parent Algorithm Node exists; the no-feedback root reference has zero scored decisions, zero adaptive-state installations, and zero adaptive descendants.
observable_measurements.value: The implemented accept/reject bookkeeping is internally consistent on every scored transition: independent recomputation of beta*score_delta + log(q_reverse) - log(q_forward), its clipped exponential probability, and draw < probability reproduced 950/950 logged decisions. All 500/500 accepted moves installed candidate smiles and score, all 450/450 rejected moves retained parent smiles and score, and all 50 per-task chain sequences (10 chains on each of five tasks, 19 transitions each) used the preceding resulting state as the next parent. Of 950 emitted offspring, 890 descended from chains already marked adaptive. Shutdown counters add six internally constructed but never emitted descendants on each failed twentieth batch, giving 920 internal descendants versus 890 emitted/scored descendants. This confirms persistent feedback for the implemented rule, but not the claimed reversible-MH invariant.

observable_measurements.name: annealed_chain_score_concentration
observable_measurements.parent_value: No Parent Algorithm Node exists. The directly observed within-session first-half chain-state statistics are the comparison baseline: mean 0.12560129858973842, maximum 0.14625335834856193, and fraction above own initial score 0.4306666666666667.
observable_measurements.value: Across the 75 first-half feedback boundaries observed before the schedule midpoint (15 per task) and the 20 later boundaries reached before failure (4 per task), the cross-task boundary mean of the ten-chain mean score decreased from 0.12560129858973842 to 0.12405784096004764, the boundary mean of the chain maximum decreased from 0.14625335834856193 to 0.14008002988249316, and the mean fraction of chains above their own initial score decreased from 0.4306666666666667 to 0.42000000000000004. First-to-later-half mean chain scores were deco_hop 0.49784483147506314 to 0.49450326414426526, drd2_docking 0.02623305282820336 to 0.028865653336333848, median_2 0.10319871514649372 to 0.09692028731963902, sitagliptin_mpo 0.000028020101371986668 to 0.0, and zaleplon_mpo 0.0007018733975600068 to 0.0; only drd2_docking increased. Accepted non-downhill transitions numbered 253 then 6 across the two observed halves, while accepted downhill transitions numbered 237 then 4. The exact offspring sequence and accept/reject sequence were identical on all five objectives despite different oracle values, and no session reached the last 100 oracle calls or the final inverse temperature, so the predicted late score concentration did not occur in the available replica.

observable_measurements.name: valid_novel_reversible_edit_yield
observable_measurements.parent_value: No Parent Algorithm Node exists. Relative to a zero-success reference, completed rounds have positive novel-valid edit yield, but there is no parent-node yield measurement and no full-budget batch-filling result.
observable_measurements.value: The 95 completed suggestion rounds emitted 950 unique sanitized canonical offspring from 9,755 logged raw edit draws, aggregate yield 0.097385955920041. Round yield ranged from 0.016778523489932886 to 0.625 with median 0.13157894736842105. Logged rejection accounting over those rounds was 4,190 absent eligible moves, 4,215 edit-or-sanitization failures, 0 unchanged products, 400 previously proposed molecules, 0 within-batch collisions, and 0 raw reverse-support failures. Every completed generation record emitted exactly the announced 10 molecules. Operational yield was not sustained: after 19 completed batches and 190 adaptive calls per task, all five twentieth suggestion attempts raised 'chain 6 could not produce a novel reversible edit' after that chain's 2,500 local attempts, emitted no batch, and left the failed-round category counts unlogged; each task therefore stopped at 200 total oracle calls rather than 300.

possible_failure_causes: The permanent evaluated/emitted novelty set removes the parent endpoint from every future emitted batch, so the actual reverse probability of every scored transition is zero even though the unfiltered structural edit has positive raw mass.

Retrying absent, invalid, forbidden, and colliding raw draws until a candidate survives conditions the emitted proposal distribution; the logged 0.5*multiplicity/choice-count probabilities omit that state- and history-dependent normalization and therefore cannot supply the exact Metropolis-Hastings correction.

Raw proposal asymmetry dominated oracle score differences: all 485 addition proposals were accepted but only 15/465 deletion proposals were accepted, and the complete structural and accept/reject paths were identical across all five objectives. This can drive molecular growth without objective-specific steering.

Permanent rejection of every prior proposal, including candidates rejected by the MH rule, progressively exhausts each chain's local support. The completed rounds already required 9,755 raw draws for 950 outputs, and all tasks then exhausted the 2,500-attempt allowance on chain 6.

The 80-heavy-atom ceiling, a 64-fragment vocabulary with many absent deletion identities, and repeated single-fragment additions plausibly amplify late edit/sanitization and absent-move failures; failed-round counters are emitted only after successful batch construction, so their exact terminal contributions are unavailable.
Because every task stopped after 190 of 290 adaptive calls at actual beta 7.148614539614657, late-session mixing and concentration at beta 28.0 were not observed.

The evidence supports single corpus-fragment additions and deletions as a forward-only de novo proposal mechanism with canonicalization and provenance; it does not support treating the novelty-filtered emitted process as a reversible Markov kernel.

A valid reversible-MH interpretation requires reverse endpoints, including evaluated parents, to remain in proposal support and requires q_forward and q_reverse to include the normalization induced by validity, novelty, retry, and within-batch conditioning. Those conditions do not hold here.

The annealing arithmetic is directionally supported only for nonsaturated downhill cases: 139/373 paired final-beta contrasts were negative, while 234/373 were unchanged at zero contrast because the raw proposal ratio saturated acceptance.
Persistent-chain installation and retention are supported for all 950 scored transitions under the implemented accept/reject rule, independent of whether that rule is valid MH.

Objective-specific concentration is not supported under the observed score scale and proposal asymmetry: only drd2_docking increased its later-half mean chain score, and all five objectives followed the same molecular and decision path.

Sustained operation at batch size 10 and budget 300 is not supported. Applicability is limited to the first 190 adaptive calls in this replica, before global novelty and local edit constraints prevent a complete batch.

applicability_conditions: The ten fixed initial molecules are sanitizable and have nonempty reversible add-or-delete neighborhoods under the prepared fragment vocabulary.
The unlabeled corpus yields a bounded set of chemically useful single-attachment fragments with enough support to define productive local edits without retrieving whole corpus molecules.
Objective values are stable and sufficiently varied for annealed score-density ratios to distinguish transitions and steer later chain states.
Useful high-scoring regions are connected to at least one initial chain by a sequence of the supported fragment additions and deletions, potentially including intermediate downhill steps.
Local editing, sanitization, and novelty filtering maintain enough yield to fill every protocol-announced batch before the evaluator's proposal-attempt limit.

The 290 adaptive calls provide enough transitions for persistent chains to mix before the increasing inverse temperature concentrates them; the method may underperform when improvements require coordinated nonlocal edits, fragments outside corpus support, or structural valleys too wide for the schedule and budget.
research_intent.falsifier: The root mechanism is falsified if emitted proposals cannot be traced to single fragment add-or-delete transitions with finite positive forward and reverse probability under the fixed uniform kernel, if recorded Metropolis-Hastings decisions do not reproduce the annealed score-density and proposal-ratio calculation, if accepted and rejected decisions do not respectively advance and retain their persistent chain states, or if increasing inverse temperature does not reduce the calculated acceptance probability of otherwise identical downhill transitions.
research_intent.implementation_change: Implement prepare mode to derive and publish a bounded, deduplicated vocabulary of single-attachment fragments and fixed proposal metadata from the unlabeled corpus, without retaining or ranking whole corpus molecules. Implement run mode to seed every RNG from init, canonicalize the fixed observations as persistent chain states, read the announced batch size, and assign each batch position to a chain. For each assigned chain, sample uniformly from its eligible reversible fragment-add and fragment-delete move records, sanitize and canonicalize the edited graph, locally retry invalid, unchanged, previously proposed, or within-batch duplicate products, and retain parent, edit, fragment, and forward-kernel provenance for every emitted molecule. After observe, compute the aggregate forward and reverse probabilities of the realized canonical transition under the same uniform kernel, apply the seeded Metropolis-Hastings test using the old and new oracle scores and a deterministic increasing inverse-temperature schedule based only on consumed budget, advance the chain only on acceptance, and otherwise preserve its prior evaluated state.
research_intent.mechanism: Maintain one persistent molecular-graph Markov chain from each fixed initial molecule, propose one fresh molecule per chain through a single reversible corpus-fragment add or delete transition, and use each returned oracle score in a Metropolis-Hastings decision targeting an annealed score density with the exact reverse-to-forward proposal probability ratio. Increase inverse temperature over the objective session so early chains can retain controlled downhill transitions while later decisions increasingly concentrate the chains on higher-scoring states.
research_intent.observed_bottleneck: With only 290 adaptive oracle calls after the ten fixed initial molecules, a de novo optimizer must use each sparse batch of feedback immediately while continuing to produce valid novel structures, and it must cross locally unfavorable structural steps without relying on a smooth surrogate, a learned policy, or screening a finite corpus pool.
